dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I was just studying the ships here at Port Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Though Raimondo is likely going to order a "reorganization" of my project... which really means terminate.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: But I've spent too long on this research to just let it go.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but start to compare the differences in design between these ships and aquabuses...
